title: Selected-coordinate principal opens of the compatible-root tower
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbf N$, $t:\{1,\ldots,r\}\to R$, and $p\in\mathbf N$. Let $A_{p,t}$ be the compatible root algebra with the positive prime-to-$p$ root and divisibility relations [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module], and let $\iota:R\to A_{p,t}$ be its structural map. For any subset $s\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$ define the selected-coordinate open of $T=\operatorname{Spec}A_{p,t}$ to be $D(\iota(\prod_{j\in s}t_j))\subseteq T$. It is the actual principal open obtained by inverting that product; its open subscheme and inclusion are the ordinary open-subscheme construction. The empty subset uses the product $1$ and hence gives all of $T$.
